question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH q4_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, 
         t.calendar_year,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT q19.cust_city
  FROM q4_sales q19
  JOIN q4_sales q20 ON q19.cust_city = q20.cust_city
  WHERE q19.calendar_year = 2019 AND q20.calendar_year = 2020
    AND q19.total_sales > 0
    AND 1.0 * (q20.total_sales - q19.total_sales) / q19.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_year_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, calendar_year, SUM(product_sales) as product_total
  FROM city_product_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_year
),
product_totals AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_total) as total_sales
  FROM product_year_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as percentile
  FROM product_totals
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id FROM ranked_products WHERE percentile = 1
),
total_sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT t.calendar_year, SUM(s.amount_sold) as year_total
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
product_share AS (
  SELECT pys.prod_id, pys.calendar_year, 
         pys.product_total,
         ts.year_total,
         1.0 * pys.product_total / ts.year_total as share
  FROM product_year_sales pys
  JOIN top_products tp ON pys.prod_id = tp.prod_id
  JOIN total_sales_by_year ts ON pys.calendar_year = ts.calendar_year
),
share_pivot AS (
  SELECT sp.prod_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2019,
         MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2020
  FROM product_share sp
  GROUP BY sp.prod_id
)
SELECT sp.prod_id, 
       p.prod_name,
       sp.share_2019, 
       sp.share_2020, 
       sp.share_2020 - sp.share_2019 as share_change
FROM share_pivot sp
LEFT JOIN products p ON sp.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY share_change DESC

  SELECT c.cust_city, 
         t.calendar_year,

  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'

    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)

),

  SELECT q19.cust_city
  FROM q4_sales q19
  JOIN q4_sales q20 ON q19.cust_city = q20.cust_city
  WHERE q19.calendar_year = 2019 AND q20.calendar_year = 2020
    AND q19.total_sales > 0
    AND 1.0 * (q20.total_sales - q19.total_sales) / q19.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
